summary: The customer is evaluating an in situ spectroscopy pilot to monitor glucose and lactate in an aqueous cell culture process against existing laboratory sample measurements.

facts_stated.text: The process is a cell culture operated in an aqueous medium.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: cell culture process in an aqueous medium

facts_stated.text: Glucose and lactate are currently measured from offline/at-line samples, causing delays in detecting changes.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: Glucose and lactate are measured from samples, and the delay makes it difficult to see changes promptly

facts_stated.text: The medium composition and cell population vary throughout the process run.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: medium and cell population change during the run

facts_stated.text: Probe hardware and calibration strategy have not been chosen yet.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: we have not yet selected a probe or a calibration strategy
